about_short_description.short_description: Bun is a JavaScript runtime for developing and managing web applications.

product.name: Bun JavaScript Runtime
product.description: A JavaScript and TypeScript runtime designed to execute server-side applications and scripts, with Node.js and web API compatibility, built-in TypeScript and JSX support, and native APIs for common application tasks.

product.name: Bun Package Manager
product.description: An npm-compatible package manager for installing, updating, and publishing JavaScript dependencies, with workspaces, global caching, lockfiles, security controls, and support for existing Node.js projects.

product.name: Bun Bundler
product.description: A native bundler and build tool for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, React, CSS, HTML, and related assets, supporting browser, server, and standalone executable builds.

product.name: Bun Test Runner
product.description: A Jest-compatible test runner for JavaScript and TypeScript with assertions, snapshots, watch mode, concurrent execution, DOM support, and built-in code coverage.
